summary: Proposal under Section 25, RBI Act 1934 **Quick Hits — Bank/NBFC/Insurance product & regulatory approvals (Tier B+):**.

items: Proposal under Section 25, RBI Act 1934 **Quick Hits — Bank/NBFC/Insurance product & regulatory approvals (Tier B+):**.
Google Pay Flex SBI Card — Google Pay's **2nd** co-branded card in India (1st: Axis Bank, Dec 2025); RuPay & Visa variants.
Kiwi Postpaid (with YES Bank) — Kiwi's first credit-line-on-UPI partnership; Kiwi also runs co-branded cards with AU SFB, YES Bank, Axis, PNB.
HDFC Bank 'Max for Seniors' (₹3.19 Cr accidental death cover) & 'Max for Her' (₹10 lakh accidental death cover).
Moody's assigns Baa2 (first-time investment-grade) rating to RBL Bank — stable outlook, 2-notch uplift via Emirates NBD affiliate support.

Private banks lead FCNR(B) deposit drive — ICICI, Kotak, Axis, HDFC each mobilised >$1 bn; among PSBs only SBI & BoB crossed $1 bn; foreign banks (HSBC+SCB) matched all 12 PSBs combined (5 Jun–30 Jul 2026 window).
AD Category-II (FEMA 2026) licences: WSFx Global Pay, Paul Merchants, Indel Remit, Niyo Forex (via Kanji Forex) — ₹25 lakh remittance ceiling recurs across all four.
IndusInd Bank — RBI nod for wholly-owned stock-broking subsidiary; separately fined ₹59.20 lakh for deposit-rate/securitisation non-compliance; also launched co-branded RuPay card with EazyDiner.
Kotak Mahindra Bank launches hybrid home loan — fixed+floating lock up to 65 months.
Karnataka Bank 'KBL Finsurance' platform (powered by SprintMoney).

Amit Shah receives ₹22.90 crore dividend cheque from REPCO Bank (30% dividend on GoI's ₹76.32 cr share capital); REPCO Bank under **MHA** (not RBI/Finance Ministry — common trap); operates only AP, Karnataka, Kerala, TN; registered 1969.
NRIs can invest in Indian MFs via GIFT City — The Wealth Company IFSC FoF, open-ended Cat III AIF.
S&P assigns IDFC FIRST Bank investment-grade rating — BBB- (long-term), A-3 (short-term), Stable.
Bank of India (NZ) launches 'BOINZ – Freedom' app.
120th Foundation Day of Indian Bank (15 Aug).
Jacob Diamond (184.75 carats, Golconda-linked) — kept in RBI's Mumbai vaults.
NPS e-Shramik (PFRDA framework, Oct 2025) — for gig/platform workers, no fixed min/max contribution.
DFS Insurance & Banking Divisions rank in GRAI (Jun 2026): Insurance Div 3rd | Banking Div 6th.
SBI Life + J&K Bank corporate agency partnership (aligned with IRDAI's "Insurance for All by 2047").
IN-SPACe proposes ₹500 Cr third-party insurance cover for space launches — covers ground damage + damage to other space objects; Govt also an insured entity; validity 1 year.
Bajaj General Insurance's 'ProShield' (defence personnel motor cover) + Swiss Re Corporate Solutions MoU.
Galaxy Health Insurance's 'Galaxy Fly Global Travel Insurance.'.
ICICI Lombard — India's first Motor Cyber Insurance Cover; also marked 25th anniversary (3 Aug 2026).

PNB MetLife '360 Health Saving Plan' (health ULIP); SBI General 'Chuniye Bharosa, Apno Sa' campaign (brand ambassador Pankaj Tripathi; MD&CEO Naveen Chandra Jha). 🚫 Duplicate — ₹25 lakh AD-II remittance ceiling repeated across 4 entities; logged once.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — First large-scale polymer note trial; Section 25, RBI Act 1934.
